newsitem.title: CANADA: Repap to review options, decide next week.
newsitem.headline: Repap to review options, decide next week.

text.p: Pulp and paper company Repap Enterprises Inc said on Wednesday it is disappointed at the rejection of the Repap-Avenor merger deal by Avenor Inc shareholders and would review its options.

"At this point, we will review the situation with our board of directors and other interested parties and choose a strategy that is in the best interest of preserving and creating value for Repap's shareholders," Repap Chief Executive George Petty said in a statement.
"We will advise our shareholders of our alternative plans during the course of next week," he added.
Petty said Repap was "very disappointed" with the Avenor shareholders' reaction.
"We believe that this merger would have produced a strong company that would have delivered significant value to the shareholders of both companies," Petty said.
The company said it is business as usual following the rejection of the merger deal.
